question: Three numbers are in the ratio 1: 11:19, and their LCM is 8778. Their HCF is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **HCF** be **x**.

Numbers are **x**, **11x**, and **19x**.

LCM of (1, 11, 19) × **HCF** = **Given LCM**

Since 1, 11, and 19 are **coprime**, their LCM is 1 × 11 × 19 = 209.

209 × **x** = 8778 ⇒ **x** = 8778 ÷ 209 = 42.

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of three numbers = 1 : 11 : 19 and **LCM** = 8778.

**Formula:** LCM of numbers = HCF × (Product of ratios if they are coprime).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3099d19a2fe39d155ecffad58819f05c8a2934ebfee17543c10eddaae0b81216.png] 

⇒ Let the numbers be 1x, 11x, and 19x where **x** is the **HCF**.

⇒ **LCM** (x, 11x, 19x) = x × **LCM** (1, 11, 19)

⇒ Since 1, 11, and 19 have no common factors, **LCM** = x × 1 × 11 × 19 = 209x.

⇒ 209x = 8778

⇒ x = 8778 ÷ 209

⇒ x = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and HCF Relationship

For two numbers a and b, **HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b**. This does not directly apply to three or more numbers.

Coprime Numbers

If numbers are **coprime**, their **HCF** is 1 and their **LCM** is the product of the numbers.

Ratio Property

If the ratio of numbers is a:b:c and their **HCF** is k, then the numbers are ak, bk, and ck.</p
